P1_xi_nontrivial_joint_shell.interpretation: I_c > 0 on Bell state witnesses that Ξ is non-trivial in the joint (Hopf+Weyl) shell; entangled pure state has S(AB)=0 and S(A)=log(2) so I_c=log(2).

P2_xi_trivial_product.interpretation: I_c ≤ 0 on product state confirms Ξ=0 outside the entangled region; product pure state has S(A)=0, so I_c=0.

P3_xi_gradient_shell_boundary.interpretation: Non-zero ∂I_c/∂η at η=0.5 confirms Ξ is not flat on the shell boundary; gradient is load-bearing for the bridge claim that Ξ co-varies with shell mixing parameter.

P_sympy_identity_check.interpretation: Symbolic: I_c = S(A) for pure states (S_AB=0); I_c = 0 for product pure states (S_A=0, S_AB=0).

N1_z3_xi_trivial_unsat.encoding: Variables: Ic, SA, SAB (Real). Constraints: SA>=0, SAB>=0, SA<=log(2), Ic==SA-SAB, Ic==0 (claim: trivial), SA>0 (entangled), SAB==0 (pure). UNSAT because SA>0 and SAB=0 → Ic=SA>0, contradicts Ic=0.
N1_z3_xi_trivial_unsat.interpretation: UNSAT confirms: Ξ=0 is structurally impossible when the joint shell state is pure and entangled. Ξ emergence is necessary, not optional.

N2_z3_data_processing_unsat.encoding: Variables: Ic_before, Ic_after, delta (Real). Constraints: Ic_before>=0, Ic_after>=0, delta>=0, Ic_after==Ic_before-delta (data-processing), Ic_after>Ic_before (claim: local op increased I_c). UNSAT because delta>=0 means Ic_after<=Ic_before, contradicting Ic_after>Ic_before.
N2_z3_data_processing_unsat.interpretation: UNSAT confirms: no local operation on A can increase I_c. Data-processing inequality is structurally necessary.

B2_bell_state_ic_log2.interpretation: At η=1 (Bell state |Φ+⟩), I_c=log(2)≈0.6931 — maximum coherent information for 2-qubit system.

B3_midpoint_ic_between_bounds.interpretation: At η=0.5, I_c is strictly between 0 and log(2).

B4_ic_monotone_in_eta.interpretation: I_c is non-decreasing in η for |ψ(η)⟩=cos(θ)|00⟩+sin(θ)|11⟩ with θ=(π/4)η; monotone increase from 0 to log(2) confirms smooth Ξ emergence across the shell boundary.
